hypothesis.statement: Higher volatility regimes should be associated with higher expected returns (risk compensation) at intermediate horizons
hypothesis.mechanism: Volatility regimes persist and influence investor risk appetite, affecting expected returns over multi-week periods
hypothesis.population: US equities in DS-EXP-050 and DS-EXP-100 universes
hypothesis.falsification_criteria: If volatility regime shows no predictive IC at H-10 or H-20, or if IC is negative, hypothesis is falsified
